troubleshoot-e217.sample_answer:
KB-101: LC-900 pressure fluctuation (error E-217)

Steps:
1) Degas your solvents and purge each pump channel for 5 minutes.
2) Check the inlet filters and replace them if they are discoloured.
3) Inspect the pump seals for leaks.

If E-217 persists after these steps, please open a service case—the pump seals need replacement by a Helix engineer. I can open a service case for you if you’d like.

troubleshoot-e330.sample_answer:
KB-102: MS-450 vacuum warning (error E-330)
- Allow 30 minutes of pump-down time after power-on.
- Check that the vent valve is fully closed.
- Do not attempt to open the vacuum chamber.
If the warning persists after 30 minutes, please open a service case for an engineer visit. I can arrange that—just let me know.

troubleshoot-network-injection.sample_answer:
KB-103: Resetting instrument network settings (LC-900, MS-450)
1) On the instrument panel, go to Settings > Network.
2) Select “Reset to defaults” and confirm.
3) Restart the instrument, then re-enter the static IP address provided by your IT team.

If your model isn’t LC-900 or MS-450, tell me the model and I’ll pull the correct steps.
